proof_body:
by
  intro f hf
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, h⟩ := Metric.uniformContinuous_iff.1 hf 1 one_pos
  have key : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ), |x| ≤ n * (δ / 2) → |f x - f 0| ≤ n := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro x hx
      have hx0 : x = 0 := by
        have h1 : |x| ≤ 0 := by simpa using hx
        exact abs_nonpos_iff.1 h1
      simp [hx0]
    | succ n ih =>
      intro x hx
      push_cast at hx ⊢
      have hn : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
      have hy : |x * ((n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1))| ≤ n * (δ / 2) := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1))]
        have h1 : |x| * ((n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) * (δ / 2) * ((n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hx (by positivity)
        have h2 : ((n : ℝ) + 1) * (δ / 2) * ((n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) = n * (δ / 2) := by
          field_simp
        linarith
      have hxy : dist x (x * ((n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1))) < δ := by
        rw [Real.dist_eq]
        have e : x - x * ((n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) = x / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by
          field_simp
          ring
        rw [e, abs_div, abs_of_pos hn, div_lt_iff₀ hn]
        have h3 : 0 < ((n : ℝ) + 1) * (δ / 2) := by positivity
        linarith
      have h4 := h hxy
      rw [Real.dist_eq] at h4
      have h5 := ih _ hy
      have h6 := abs_sub_le (f x) (f (x * ((n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)))) (f 0)
      linarith
  refine ⟨2 / δ, |f 0| + 1, fun x => ?_⟩
  have h1 := Nat.le_ceil (2 * |x| / δ)
  have h2 := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (show 0 ≤ 2 * |x| / δ by positivity)
  have h3 : |x| ≤ (⌈2 * |x| / δ⌉₊ : ℝ) * (δ / 2) := by
    have h4 := (div_le_iff₀ hδ).1 h1
    linarith
  have h5 := key _ _ h3
  have h6 := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (f x) (f 0)
  have h7 : 2 * |x| / δ = 2 / δ * |x| := by ring
  linarith
target_source: ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, UniformContinuous f → ∃ A B : ℝ, ∀ x, |f x| ≤ A * |x| + B
